comment: Routing probes for unsafe Rust boundaries versus ordinary safe Rust and panic-pattern auditing.

queries.query: Fix the Rust wrapper around this C callback; the context pointer may be used after the owner is dropped.
Review and correct this unsafe Sync implementation for a wrapper around a thread-affine native handle.
Fix this synchronous Rust worker client so a non-Send foreign session is constructed, used, and destroyed on its owner thread with startup and shutdown settlement.
Export this Rust function under a fixed symbol with no_mangle and verify that its ABI and symbol contract are sound.
Fix this x86_64 asm block; its options claim it preserves memory and flags but the instructions may not.
Repair this raw-pointer table lookup that casts pointer addresses through usize before dereferencing them.
Use $unsafe-rust to design a safe abstraction over this raw pointer and document its invariants.
Fix this safe Rust borrow-checker error using ordinary ownership and lifetime changes; the crate contains no unsafe code.
Produce a repository-wide report of Rust panic sites without changing or reviewing any unsafe boundary.
Replace this Mutex-protected request counter with a safe AtomicUsize counter; the crate contains no unsafe code, raw reclamation, or unsafe trait implementation.
Add cfg and derive attributes to this entirely safe Rust data type; there are no unsafe attributes, extern declarations, or layout assumptions.
Replace repeated string allocation with an immutable static lookup table in otherwise safe Rust.
Refactor this ordinary safe function and add a safe trait bound without raw pointers, unsafe implementations, FFI, or layout-sensitive code.
An async Rust future registers an unsafe foreign callback and can be canceled before deregistration completes.
